mapper.sql: COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(d.plan_version_id) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version d WHERE d.plan_id=p.plan_id AND d.status='DRAFT'), (SELECT pv.plan_version_id FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version pv WHERE pv.plan_id=p.plan_id AND pv.version_no=p.current_version_no LIMIT 1), (SELECT MAX(a.plan_version_id) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version a WHERE a.plan_id=p.plan_id) )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*,v.plan_version_id,v.version_no,v.status version_status, (SELECT pv.plan_version_id FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version pv WHERE pv.plan_id=p.plan_id AND pv.version_no=p.current_version_no LIMIT 1) published_version_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_class pc WHERE pc.plan_version_id=v.plan_version_id) class_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question pq WHERE pq.plan_version_id=v.plan_version_id) question_count FROM biz_python_practice_plan p LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_version_id= WHERE p.dept_id=#{deptId} AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_python_practice_plan_class fpc WHERE fpc.plan_version_id=v.plan_version_id AND CAST(fpc.entry_year AS BINARY)=CAST(#{entryYear} AS BINARY)) ORDER BY p.update_time DESC,p.plan_id DESC

SELECT p.*,v.plan_version_id,v.version_no,v.status version_status, (SELECT pv.plan_version_id FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version pv WHERE pv.plan_id=p.plan_id AND pv.version_no=p.current_version_no LIMIT 1) published_version_id FROM biz_python_practice_plan p LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_version_id= WHERE p.plan_id=#{planId}

SELECT p.*,v.plan_version_id,v.version_no,v.status version_status FROM biz_python_practice_plan p JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_id=p.plan_id WHERE v.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId}

SELECT p.*,v.plan_version_id,v.version_no,v.status version_status FROM biz_python_practice_plan p JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_id=p.plan_id AND v.status='DRAFT' WHERE p.plan_id=#{planId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version WHERE plan_id=#{planId}

SELECT q.plan_question_id,q.question_id,q.sort_no,q.stage,q.required_flag,s.snapshot_id,s.question_title, s.difficulty,s.knowledge_points,s.no_input,s.question_content,s.input_description,s.output_description, s.sample_explanation,s.constraints_text,s.notes_text,s.starter_code,s.language_code, s.time_limit_seconds,s.memory_limit_kb FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE q.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} ORDER BY q.sort_no,q.plan_question_id
SELECT plan_class_id,plan_version_id,dept_id,entry_year,class_code FROM biz_python_practice_plan_class WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} ORDER BY entry_year,class_code

choose.when: SELECT s.entry_year,s.class_code,COUNT(*) student_count FROM biz_student s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE u.dept_id=#{deptId} AND s.entry_year IS NOT NULL AND s.class_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.entry_year,s.class_code ORDER BY s.entry_year DESC,s.class_code
choose.otherwise: SELECT tc.entry_year,tc.class_code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_student s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.dept_id=tc.dept_id WHERE CAST(s.entry_year AS BINARY)=CAST(tc.entry_year AS BINARY) AND CAST(s.class_code AS BINARY)=CAST(tc.class_code AS BINARY)) student_count FROM biz_teacher_class tc WHERE tc.user_id=#{userId} AND tc.dept_id=#{deptId} ORDER BY tc.entry_year DESC,tc.class_code

mapper.select: SELECT q.question_id,q.difficulty,c.external_id,c.title,c.knowledge_points FROM biz_question q JOIN biz_programming_question_config c ON c.question_id=q.question_id WHERE q.question_type='practical' AND q.practical_mode='PYTHON' AND c.create_by='python-system-v2' AND q.is_public IN ('Y','1') AND c.enabled='1' AND c.validation_status='VALID' AND c.external_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question pq WHERE pq.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND pq.question_id=q.question_id) ORDER BY c.external_id,q.question_id

SELECT 'BASE_VERSION' source_type,v.plan_version_id source_id,p.plan_id,p.plan_name,q.question_id,q.sort_no, q.stage,q.required_flag,s.snapshot_id,s.question_title,s.difficulty,s.knowledge_points,s.no_input, s.question_content,s.input_description,s.output_description,s.sample_explanation,s.constraints_text, s.notes_text,s.starter_code,s.language_code,s.time_limit_seconds,s.memory_limit_kb FROM biz_python_practice_plan p JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_id=p.plan_id AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND v.version_no=p.current_version_no JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_class pc ON pc.plan_version_id=v.plan_version_id AND pc.dept_id=#{deptId} AND CAST(pc.entry_year AS BINARY)=CAST(#{entryYear} AS BINARY) AND CAST(pc.class_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{classCode} AS BINARY) JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_question q ON q.plan_version_id=v.plan_version_id JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE p.dept_id=#{deptId} AND p.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.plan_id DESC,q.sort_no,q.plan_question_id
SELECT s.* FROM biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s WHERE s.source_type=#{sourceType} AND s.source_id=#{sourceId} AND s.question_id=#{questionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM biz_python_practice_draft WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_draft(student_id,source_type,source_id,question_id,snapshot_id,source_code,update_time) VALUES(#{studentId},#{sourceType},#{sourceId},#{questionId},#{snapshotId},#{sourceCode},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE snapshot_id=VALUES(snapshot_id),source_code=VALUES(source_code),update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT submission_id,submission_key,source_type,source_id,question_id,submit_type,status_code,status_message,score,passed_case_count,total_case_count,judge_summary,submitted_at,judged_at FROM biz_python_practice_submission WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND question_id=#{questionId} ORDER BY submission_id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT p.*,s.time_limit_seconds,s.memory_limit_kb FROM biz_python_practice_submission p JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=p.snapshot_id WHERE p.submission_id=#{submissionId}

SELECT r.submission_case_id,r.submission_id,r.case_name,r.is_public,r.status_code,r.judge0_status_id,r.time_seconds,r.memory_kb,r.order_num, CASE WHEN r.is_public='1' THEN COALESCE(c.input_text,p.custom_input) ELSE NULL END input_text, CASE WHEN r.is_public='1' THEN c.expected_output ELSE NULL END expected_output, CASE WHEN r.is_public='1' THEN r.output_text ELSE NULL END output_text, CASE WHEN r.is_public='1' THEN r.error_summary ELSE NULL END error_summary FROM biz_python_practice_submission_case r JOIN biz_python_practice_submission p ON p.submission_id=r.submission_id LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_snapshot_case c ON c.snapshot_case_id=r.snapshot_case_id WHERE r.submission_id=#{submissionId} ORDER BY r.order_num,r.submission_case_id

SELECT c.*,s.time_limit_seconds,s.memory_limit_kb FROM biz_python_practice_snapshot_case c JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=c.snapshot_id WHERE c.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND c.is_public='1' ORDER BY c.order_num
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_python_practice_submission SET status_code='JUDGING',status_message='判题中' WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status_code='WAITING'

UPDATE biz_python_practice_submission SET status_code=#{statusCode},status_message=#{statusMessage},score=#{score},passed_case_count=#{passedCaseCount},total_case_count=#{totalCaseCount},judge_summary=#{judgeSummary},judged_at=NOW() WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status_code IN ('WAITING','JUDGING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_submission_case(submission_id,snapshot_case_id,case_name,is_public,status_code,judge0_status_id,time_seconds,memory_kb,output_text,error_summary,order_num) VALUES(#{submissionId},#{snapshotCaseId},#{caseName},#{isPublic},#{statusCode},#{judge0StatusId},#{timeSeconds},#{memoryKb},#{outputText},#{errorSummary},#{orderNum}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE snapshot_case_id=VALUES(snapshot_case_id),case_name=VALUES(case_name),is_public=VALUES(is_public),status_code=VALUES(status_code),judge0_status_id=VALUES(judge0_status_id),time_seconds=VALUES(time_seconds),memory_kb=VALUES(memory_kb),output_text=VALUES(output_text),error_summary=VALUES(error_summary)

INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_plan_class(plan_version_id,dept_id,entry_year,class_code,create_by,create_time) SELECT #{toVersionId},dept_id,entry_year,class_code,#{createBy},NOW() FROM biz_python_practice_plan_class WHERE plan_version_id=#{fromVersionId}

INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_question_snapshot(source_type,source_id,question_id,snapshot_hash,question_title,difficulty,knowledge_points,no_input,question_content,input_description,output_description,sample_explanation,constraints_text,notes_text,starter_code,language_code,time_limit_seconds,memory_limit_kb,max_processes,max_file_size_kb,max_output_kb,create_by,create_time) SELECT 'BASE_VERSION',#{toVersionId},question_id,REPLACE(UUID(),'-',''),question_title,difficulty,knowledge_points,no_input,question_content,input_description,output_description,sample_explanation,constraints_text,notes_text,starter_code,language_code,time_limit_seconds,memory_limit_kb,max_processes,max_file_size_kb,max_output_kb,#{createBy},NOW() FROM biz_python_practice_question_snapshot WHERE source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND source_id=#{fromVersionId}

INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_snapshot_case(snapshot_id,case_name,input_text,expected_output,is_public,score_weight,order_num) SELECT ns.snapshot_id,c.case_name,c.input_text,c.expected_output,c.is_public,c.score_weight,c.order_num FROM biz_python_practice_question_snapshot os JOIN biz_python_practice_snapshot_case c ON c.snapshot_id=os.snapshot_id JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot ns ON ns.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND ns.source_id=#{toVersionId} AND ns.question_id=os.question_id WHERE os.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND os.source_id=#{fromVersionId}

INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_plan_question(plan_version_id,question_id,snapshot_id,sort_no,stage,required_flag) SELECT #{toVersionId},q.question_id,ns.snapshot_id,q.sort_no,q.stage,q.required_flag FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot ns ON ns.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND ns.source_id=#{toVersionId} AND ns.question_id=q.question_id WHERE q.plan_version_id=#{fromVersionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_class WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_python_practice_plan_question SET sort_no=-(sort_no+1000000) WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId}
UPDATE biz_python_practice_plan_question SET sort_no=#{sortNo} WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
UPDATE biz_python_practice_plan_version SET status='RETRACTED',update_time=NOW() WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND (#{exceptVersionId} IS NULL OR plan_version_id<>#{exceptVersionId})
UPDATE biz_python_practice_plan_version SET status='PUBLISHED',published_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','PUBLISHED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.snapshot_id) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_snapshot_case c ON c.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE q.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND c.is_public='1''0'
SELECT version_no FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM biz_python_practice_draft WHERE source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND source_id IN (SELECT plan_version_id FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version WHERE plan_id=#{planId})

DELETE c FROM biz_python_practice_submission_case c JOIN biz_python_practice_submission s ON s.submission_id=c.submission_id WHERE s.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND s.source_id IN (SELECT plan_version_id FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version WHERE plan_id=#{planId})
DELETE FROM biz_python_practice_submission WHERE source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND source_id IN (SELECT plan_version_id FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version WHERE plan_id=#{planId})
DELETE FROM biz_python_practice_progress WHERE source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND source_id IN (SELECT plan_version_id FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version WHERE plan_id=#{planId})
DELETE pc FROM biz_python_practice_plan_class pc JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_version_id=pc.plan_version_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId}

DELETE c FROM biz_python_practice_snapshot_case c JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=c.snapshot_id JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON s.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND s.source_id=v.plan_version_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId}
DELETE s FROM biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON s.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND s.source_id=v.plan_version_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId}
DELETE q FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_version_id=q.plan_version_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId}
DELETE q FROM biz_python_practice_extension_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_extension e ON e.extension_id=q.extension_id WHERE e.plan_id=#{planId}
DELETE c FROM biz_python_practice_extension_class c JOIN biz_python_practice_extension e ON e.extension_id=c.extension_id WHERE e.plan_id=#{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_class WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND dept_id=#{deptId} AND CAST(entry_year AS BINARY)=CAST(#{entryYear} AS BINARY) AND CAST(class_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{classCode} AS BINARY)

SELECT s.student_id,s.student_no,u.nick_name student_name,pc.entry_year,pc.class_code, COUNT(DISTINCT q.question_id) question_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.progress_id IS NOT NULL THEN q.question_id END) attempted_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.passed_flag='1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) passed_count, COALESCE(SUM(pr.submit_count),0) submit_count,MAX(pr.last_practice_time) last_practice_time FROM biz_python_practice_plan_class pc JOIN biz_student s ON CAST(s.entry_year AS BINARY)=CAST(pc.entry_year AS BINARY) AND CAST(s.class_code AS BINARY)=CAST(pc.class_code AS BINARY) JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.dept_id=pc.dept_id JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_question q ON q.plan_version_id=pc.plan_version_id LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_progress pr ON pr.student_id=s.student_id AND pr.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND pr.source_id=pc.plan_version_id AND pr.question_id=q.question_id WHERE pc.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND pc.dept_id=#{deptId} AND CAST(pc.entry_year AS BINARY)=CAST(#{entryYear} AS BINARY) AND CAST(pc.class_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{classCode} AS BINARY) GROUP BY s.student_id,s.student_no,u.nick_name,pc.entry_year,pc.class_code ORDER BY pc.entry_year, CAST(pc.class_code AS UNSIGNED), pc.class_code, CAST(s.student_no AS UNSIGNED), s.student_no

SELECT q.question_id,snap.question_title,snap.difficulty,snap.knowledge_points, COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) target_student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.progress_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.student_id END) attempted_student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.passed_flag='1' THEN s.student_id END) passed_student_count, COALESCE(SUM(pr.submit_count),0) submit_count FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot snap ON snap.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_class pc ON pc.plan_version_id=q.plan_version_id JOIN biz_student s ON CAST(s.entry_year AS BINARY)=CAST(pc.entry_year AS BINARY) AND CAST(s.class_code AS BINARY)=CAST(pc.class_code AS BINARY) JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.dept_id=pc.dept_id LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_progress pr ON pr.student_id=s.student_id AND pr.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND pr.source_id=q.plan_version_id AND pr.question_id=q.question_id WHERE q.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND pc.dept_id=#{deptId} AND CAST(pc.entry_year AS BINARY)=CAST(#{entryYear} AS BINARY) AND CAST(pc.class_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{classCode} AS BINARY) GROUP BY q.question_id,q.sort_no,snap.question_title,snap.difficulty,snap.knowledge_points ORDER BY q.sort_no
SELECT source_type,source_id,question_id,best_score,passed_flag,submit_count,first_pass_time,last_practice_time FROM biz_python_practice_progress WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_progress(student_id,source_type,source_id,question_id,best_score,passed_flag,submit_count,first_pass_time,last_practice_time) VALUES(#{studentId},#{sourceType},#{sourceId},#{questionId},#{bestScore},#{passedFlag},1,#{firstPassTime},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE best_score=GREATEST(best_score,VALUES(best_score)),passed_flag=IF(VALUES(passed_flag)='1','1',passed_flag),submit_count=submit_count+1,first_pass_time=IF(first_pass_time IS NULL,VALUES(first_pass_time),first_pass_time),last_practice_time=NOW()
